contentText: US and Iran agreed to an “immediate and permanent” end to military operations under a surprise memorandum of understanding announced via mediator Pakistan on Sunday. The agreement includes plans to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, ease sanctions and begin further talks over nuclear issues. France 24's Kethevane Gorjestani takes a look at the deal's details and the complex issues that are still left to negotiate.
